description: Find seller companies on B2B Market by name or keywords, or list the suppliers of one category. Returns name, city, what the company sells, the number of its offers and its page URL. Give query, category_id, or both. Read one company with get_company.

category_id.description: Only companies that sell in this category (id from list_categories)

kind.description: Which catalogue category_id belongs to: products (default) or services

lang.description: Answer language: ru (default), uz, en or ch (Chinese)

query.description: Company name or keywords from its description or city, e.g. "textile Tashkent"

name: search_companies
title: Search companies (suppliers)
